name: Hohen Sprenz (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hohen Sprenz (crossed tools and a red church on white above fish on blue).
history: The blue-white striped flag with the municipal arms, developed by Helmut Otte, was approved together with the arms.

features.role: Hohen Sprenz arms — tools, church and fish
